metadata.description: looksright — your agent says the page is done. LooksRight opens it and looks.

plugins.name: looksright
plugins.description: Opens every route in a real Chrome, across viewports and themes, and runs 12 deterministic checks: blank page, console errors, failed requests, stuck loading, horizontal overflow, clipped text, invisible text, leaked markup, contrast, broken images, tiny targets, missing labels. Exits 1 on error, so it gates CI as is.
